infotexts.entitydescription.descendantservosuit: A 10,000 m powered exosuit with a compact third arm and work lights. Select repair/welding, pulse defence or tractor beam. The two visible slots hold a battery/reactor rod and a pulse laser ammunition box. Closed-loop breathing needs power, not an oxygen tank. AI replaces empty supplies. Repair uses native skills and completion talents. LuaCs required.
infotexts.descendant.title: Servo arm
infotexts.descendant.grab_help: Point at the target. Hold [InputType.Aim] and press [InputType.Use], then release the keys. The target stays suspended. Press again while aiming to release. Creatures become temporarily limp. One loose object or creature, excluding massive targets; range 300. Changing mode, an obstacle, power loss or removing the suit releases the grip.
infotexts.descendant.hide_panel: Hide panel; the function stays enabled
